paper_title: Multimessenger Constraints on Radiatively Decaying Axions from GW170817
notes: Astrophysical bound on radiatively decaying heavy axions from GW170817/GRB170817A. Paper reports excluding axion-photon couplings down to 5e-10 in the abstract text ('down to 5x10^-11 GeV^-1') for axion masses 1-400 MeV. The main result is presented as an exclusion region in Fig.3 (g_agamma vs m_a plane), not a simple curve; only the floor value (~5e-11 GeV^-1) and mass range (1-400 MeV) are given explicitly in text. Data points are approximate representation of the excluded region floor spanning the stated mass range; the actual boundary is a closed 2D region.
